title: 💰 Wakefield, MA Accounting Roles with Multiple Openings
text:
7 hours ago Wakefield’s accounting scene is buzzing, especially for folks looking to grow in public accounting and tax. If you’re studying accounting or already experienced, these roles are worth a look.
Audit Winter 2028 Internship – Boston, Braintree, & Wakefield, MA Employer: CohnReznick Location: Wakefield, MA (hybrid) Type: Full-time Winter Internship (~January–March) Pay: $35/hour in Massachusetts Hands-on audit work at a top public accounting firm, with support from a performance coach and a "CR Friend." You’ll work on real engagements (cash, reconciliations, workpapers) across industries and get mentorship that can help you toward a CPA path.
Tax Winter 2028 Internship – Boston, Braintree, & Wakefield, MA Employer: CohnReznick Location: Wakefield, MA (hybrid) Type: Winter Internship (~January–April) Pay: $35/hour in Massachusetts Perfect if you’re an accounting major aiming for tax: you’ll help prepare returns for individuals, partnerships, and corporations, and learn current tax rules on real client work. Same strong coaching and team support as the audit internship, with a focus on tax.
